description: Fix CI/CD issues: frontend test detection in CI script and document branch protection requirements for testing and main branches. These are independent of other bugs and handle the build/release process improvements.
steps: Update ci/run_tests.sh detect_vitest() function (lines 55-63) to check for frontend/vitest.config.js and frontend/vitest.config.ts in addition to root-level configs
Verify the updated detect_vitest() correctly identifies frontend config and run_vitest_tests() navigates to the frontend directory

Create .github/BRANCH_PROTECTION.md with complete branch protection settings: both testing and main branches need (1) require PR reviews with 1 approval, (2) require status checks (tests from samanvaya-qa.yml), (3) require branches up to date, (4) no force pushes, (5) no deletions. Include step-by-step instructions.
Test the CI script: run 'bash ci/run_tests.sh' from repository root and verify it detects and executes both backend (pytest) and frontend (vitest) tests
acceptance_criteria: CI script ci/run_tests.sh successfully detects frontend/vitest.config.js
CI script runs frontend tests from the frontend directory
Running 'bash ci/run_tests.sh' executes both backend and frontend test suites
Document .github/BRANCH_PROTECTION.md exists with clear instructions for GitHub repository settings
Document includes all required settings: PR reviews, status checks, branch update requirement, force push prevention
verification: Confirm both Python tests and frontend vitest tests execute
findings: CI script successfully detects frontend/vitest.config.js and runs frontend tests from the frontend directory. Both backend (pytest) and frontend (vitest) tests execute correctly. Branch protection documentation created with complete settings for both testing and main branches.
